data.headline: MacroMonitor Briefing: Normal Market Conditions (57.2/100)
data.executive_summary: As of 2026-11-24, the Global Financial Stress Composite registered 57.2/100, reflecting normal market conditions. US Net Liquidity has expanded by $23.1B over the trailing 4-week window, while institutional cash participants in India recorded net inflows (FII: ₹1,250.4 Cr) and recorded net inflows (DII: ₹1,840.2 Cr).

sections.title: Financial Stress & Volatility Breakdown
sections.content: The composite score is derived as the arithmetic mean of available cross-asset frictions: Equity: 85.4th percentile, Rates: 82.6th percentile, Fx: 21.0th percentile, Commodity: 93.3th percentile, Correlation: 58.5th percentile. No values are imputed for missing series.

sections.title: Funding & Institutional Positioning

In Indian equities, cumulative institutional absorption continues to reflect countercyclical domestic liquidity provisioning.
